mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_id, name, description, image_url, category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, branch_id, status, created_at) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}), #{name}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, UUID_TO_BIN(#{categoryId}), #{price}, #{kcal}, #{allergenInfo}, #{kind}, UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId}), #{status}, #{createdAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), image_url = VALUES(image_url), category_id = VALUES(category_id), price = VALUES(price), kcal = VALUES(kcal), allergen_info = VALUES(allergen_info), kind = VALUES(kind), branch_id = VALUES(branch_id), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM product WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, name, description, image_url, BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId})

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, name, description, image_url, BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product WHERE category_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{categoryId})

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, name, description, image_url, BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND kind = 'COMMON'

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, name, description, image_url, BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND kind = 'BRANCH_EXCLUSIVE' AND branch_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId})

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(product_id) AS product_id, name, description, image_url, BIN_TO_UUID(category_id) AS category_id, price, kcal, allergen_info, kind, BIN_TO_UUID(branch_id) AS branch_id, status, created_at FROM product WHERE product_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{productId}) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE branch_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product WHERE branch_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{branchId})
